'''Lucky Lana''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], she sold specialized gear for [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] in the Combat Training section of [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lana first appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a level 50 Battlemaster PVP Gear vendor.
